title: 3.12 Have, Has, Mine, and Yours
unit_outcome: Use tightly supported exchanges to greet people and give a name, age, origin and job, ask and answer yes/no questions with be, and describe who owns things.
goal: Say who has something with have and has, and whose it is with mine and yours.
grammar_function: I/you/we/they have; he/she has. It is mine/yours. Is it yours? Yes, it is mine.
prerequisite: 3.10-3.11 possessives, 3.4 yes/no questions, Unit 2 objects, plurals and colors.
speaking_outcome: Say what people have and answer Is it yours? with Yes, it is mine.
